description: RECOMPUTABLE agent-readiness audit of any agent URL: scores 0-100 + grade on handshake readiness (/.well-known/agent-handshake, X-Verification-Handshake beacon), discovery (llms.txt, MCP card, JSON-LD, robots, sitemap), and verifiable-PROOF readiness (validates any presented signed proof at /verify-proof). Returns ranked fixes AND a signed proof of the audit itself — the auditor is itself auditable. Every result re-derives from a public fetch.

url.description: The agent endpoint/site URL to audit (public http(s) only)

name: audit_agent_readiness
scope_note: Audits agent/verifiability READINESS (discoverable + presents a verifiable handshake/proof), not output correctness.
